descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Preparare estrazioni di dati, grafici, tabelle e uscite analitiche di primo livello utilizzando modelli standardizzati.

- Mantenere i tracker di analisi del Customer Journey, assicurando la documentazione corretta, il controllo della versione e il monitoraggio dei piani di azione.

- Supporta analisi e aggiornamenti di follow-up dopo i piloti, modifiche operative o feedback di gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

- Consolidare e analizzare i dati provenienti da più fonti, inclusi i sondaggi di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, il feedback dei nostri clienti, la formazione di NPS e i relativi indicatori degli ospiti.

- Costruire, aggiornare e mantenere le dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del programma, l'impegno e l'impatto nel tempo.

- Produrre rapporti regolari di performance e riassunti esecutivi strutturati per le recensioni di leadership.

- Assicurare la coerenza dei dati, la precisione e gli standard di report in tutti i nostri output di analisi BEST.

- Sostenere la preparazione di visualizzazioni di dati e materiali di storytelling per gli stakeholder senior.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea (o attualmente iscritta) in Business, Data Analytics, Ospitalità o un campo relativo

- Forte mentalità analitica con attenzione ai dettagli

- Avanzate competenze di Excel; la conoscenza degli strumenti di dashboard (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau) è un plus

- Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre i dati in insight strutturati

- Fluente in inglese

I tuoi essenziali

Competenze consigliate

- No.
Conoscenza di base delle metriche di soddisfazione degli ospiti e NPS

- No.
Comprensione di base delle metriche di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti

- Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione e reporting dati

- Interessi nel viaggio dei clienti, nell'esperienza degli ospiti e nel miglioramento dei servizi

- Familiarità con l'analisi dei dati dell'indagine e l'analisi a risposta aperta

Cosa ti offre questo ruolo:

- Esperienza pratica nell'analisi, sviluppo KPI e dashboard

- Esposizione all'impatto reale del business attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati

- Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Votre but

Rejoignez MSC Cruises pour un stage passionnant axé sur l'analyse, le suivi des performances et la génération de perspicaces dans deux domaines stratégiques : le parcours client et notre meilleur programme.

Ce rôle est idéal pour une personne passionnée par l'analyse des données, la génération de connaissances et la création de tableaux de bord, qui s'intéresse vivement à l'amélioration de l'expérience des employés et des invités grâce à un impact mesurable.

Vous soutiendrez le développement d'analyses structurées et de mécanismes de suivi, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le service Voyage client et RH. Ce rôle permet d'être directement exposé aux analyses axées sur les clients et les employés.

Votre impact

Voyage client:

- Soutenir les analyses récurrentes du parcours client, y compris les examens sur toile, les analyses en milieu de saison par navire et les produits livrables du comité.

- Contribuer à des analyses ad hoc sur des sujets précis, des segments invités, des nationalités ou des navires, en fonction des demandes d'affaires et de gestion.

- Préparer des extractions de données, des graphiques, des tableaux et des résultats analytiques de premier niveau à l'aide de modèles normalisés.

- Tenir des traceurs d'analyse du parcours client, assurer la documentation appropriée, le contrôle des versions et le suivi des plans d'action.

- Appuyer les analyses de suivi et les mises à jour après les projets pilotes, les changements opérationnels ou la rétroaction de la direction.

- Veiller à l'exactitude, à l'uniformité et à l'alignement des données sur les produits livrables et les rapports du Programme Voyage client.

Notre programme BEST:

- Soutenir le développement, la maintenance et le suivi des cadres KPI pour le programme NOTRE MEILLEUR.

- Consolider et analyser les données provenant de sources multiples, y compris les enquêtes sur l'engagement des employés, NOTRE meilleure rétroaction, la formation des NPF et les indicateurs pertinents des invités.

- Créer, mettre à jour et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord pour surveiller l'exécution, l'engagement et l'impact du programme au fil du temps.

- Produire régulièrement des rapports sur le rendement et des résumés structurés pour les examens des dirigeants.

- Assurer la cohérence des données, l'exactitude et les normes de rapport pour tous nos meilleurs résultats analytiques.

- Soutenir la préparation de visualisations de données et de matériel de narration pour les acteurs de haut niveau.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Diplôme (ou actuellement inscrit) en Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, ou un domaine connexe

- Forte mentalité analytique avec attention aux détails

- Compétences Excel avancées; la connaissance des outils de tableau de bord (p. ex. Power BI, Tableau) est un plus

- Fortes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de traduire les données en idées structurées

- Fluent en anglais

Vos essentiels

Compétences privilégiées

- Oui.
Compréhension de base des paramètres de satisfaction des clients et des NPS

- Oui.
Connaissance de base des paramètres de la participation des employés

- Expérience de la visualisation des données et des outils de rapport

- Intérêt pour le voyage client, l'expérience client et l'amélioration du service

- Connaissance de l'analyse des données d'enquête et de l'analyse des commentaires ouverts

Ce que ce rôle vous offre :

- Expérience pratique en analyse, développement KPI et tableau de bord

- Exposition à un impact commercial réel grâce à la prise de décisions fondées sur les données

- Possibilité de travailler dans un environnement mondial et dynamique

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

Guidare e definire la pianificazione strategica, l'implementazione e la gestione operativa del Dipartimento multimediale, supportando i sistemi audiovisivi (AV) in tutta la flotta e le infrastrutture aziendali. Superare i contenuti multimediali della flotta, l'innovazione tecnologica e le operazioni AV per massimizzare l'esperienza degli ospiti e mantenere standard di marca coerenti. Lavorare a stretto contatto con team globali, nuovi progetti di costruzione e stakeholder esterni, guidare la collaborazione tra intrattenimento, marketing, IT, digitale, produzione e funzioni tecniche per offrire esperienze digitali senza soluzione di continuità. L'ambito AV si espande oltre i tradizionali multimediali, supportando iniziative tecniche più ampie in tutta la divisione Entertainment, tra cui attività teatrali e ospiti, e fungendo da ponte chiave tra le esigenze di intrattenimento operativo e i team di consegna tecnica.

Il tuo impatto

Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Führen und definieren Sie die strategische Planung, Bereitstellung und operative Verwaltung der Multimedia-Abteilung und unterstützen Sie audiovisuelle (AV) Systeme über Flotte und Unternehmensinfrastruktur. Beaufsichtigen Sie Multimedia-Inhalte, Technologieinnovation und AV-Operationen, um die Gästeerfahrung zu maximieren und einheitliche Markenstandards zu erhalten. - Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Initiativen mit Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Produktion und technischen Stakeholdern, um innovative Gasterlebnisse an Bord und Ufer zu bieten.

- Aktivieren Sie als primäre Verbindung zwischen Unterhaltung, Produktionsanbietern, externen Vertragspartnern und der Abteilung Show und Multimedia, indem Sie kreative und operative Anforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen übersetzen.

- Neue Build-Projekte zu multimedialen und AV-technischen Anforderungen beraten und unterstützen, um eine zukunftssichere, nachhaltige Technologieintegration zu gewährleisten.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

titleByLocale.it: Direttore delle Operazioni - Infrastrutture di accoglienza

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS. Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers. For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness. 3. Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Operationsdirektor ist verantwortlich für das Design, die Mobilisierung, die Eröffnung und den laufenden Betrieb von großen Kreuzfahrt- und Gastfreundschaft-Infrastrukturanlagen. Die Rolle sorgt für Kontinuität von der Entwicklung durch stationäre Operationen, die als Betriebsinhaber von frühen Bauphasen durch langfristige Leistung fungieren. Parallel zur Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Gasterfahrung garantiert der Leiter der Geschäftstätigkeit, dass die Vermögenswerte durch Design, vollständig bereit zur Eröffnung und nachhaltig effizient, sicher und profitabel sind. Ihre Auswirkungen 1. Operationelle Führung über den Asset Lifecycle Eigene operative End-to-End-Verantwortung von der Voröffnung durch Live-Operationen. Definieren Sie die Langzeit-Betriebsvision, Kennzahlen und Servicestandards. Gewährleistung der Kontinuität von Design, Kultur und Systemen von der Projektphase bis hin zu stationären Betrieben. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Führen Sie das betriebsbereite Programm im Einklang mit Bau Meilensteinen. In Abstimmung mit Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.) definieren Sie die Beschaffungsbedürfnisse und implementieren sie. FFE/OWS. Einflussentscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Sicherheit und Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit. Stellen Sie operative Strukturen, SOPs und Governance vor der Eröffnung fest. Manage Handover von Bau zu Betrieb, einschließlich phased Umsatz. Für jedes Projekt sorgen Personalbedarf und - in Verbindung mit Personal - die operativen Fähigkeiten neuer Vermögenswerte. Ausbildungsprogramme für Betriebsbereitschaft einrichten. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direkte tägliche Operationen in allen Abteilungen (Krankheit, F&B, Einzelhandel, Attraktionen, Marine, Sicherheit, Wartung, Gastdienste). descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Directeur des opérations est responsable de la conception, de la mobilisation, de l'ouverture et de l'exploitation continue de grands équipements de croisière et d'accueil. Ce rôle assure la continuité du développement par des opérations en état d'équilibre, agissant en tant que propriétaire opérationnel depuis les premières phases de construction jusqu'à la performance à long terme. Parallèlement au développement, à la construction et à l'expérience des invités, le Directeur des opérations garantit que les actifs sont exploitables par la conception, prêts à l'ouverture et durables, sûrs et rentables par la suite. 1. Leadership opérationnel Tout au long du cycle de vie de l'actif Responsabilité opérationnelle de bout en bout de la préouverture à des opérations réelles. Définir la vision opérationnelle à long terme, les ICR et les normes de service. Assurer la continuité de la conception, de la culture et des systèmes depuis la phase du projet jusqu'aux opérations en état d'équilibre. 2. Préouverture et mobilisation (parallèle à la construction) Diriger le programme de préparation opérationnelle aligné sur les étapes de construction. En coordination avec les Services invités (F&B, HK, Entertainment, etc.), définir les besoins en matière d'approvisionnement et les mettre en oeuvre. - Oui. Influencer les décisions de conception pour assurer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la sécurité et la maintenance. Établir les structures opérationnelles, les PON et la gouvernance bien avant l'ouverture. Gérer les transferts de la construction à l'exploitation, y compris les roulements échelonnés. Pour chaque projet, déterminer les besoins en personnel et, de concert avec les RH, assurer la capacité opérationnelle des nouveaux biens. Établir des programmes de formation pour la préparation opérationnelle. 3. Gestion des opérations après l'ouverture Diriger les opérations quotidiennes dans tous les ministères (hôpital, F&B, détail, attractions, maritime, sécurité, entretien, services aux clients). Assurer la livraison de l'expérience client, la sécurité, la qualité du service et les normes de marque. Conduire la stabilité opérationnelle pendant les phases de montée en puissance et de maturité. Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble de l'actif. 4. Main-d'œuvre, formation et culture Construisez, dirigez et maintenez une main-d'oeuvre multinationale hautement performante. Maintenir et développer les programmes de formation après l'ouverture. Intégrer une culture axée sur la sécurité, le service et la performance. 5. Rendement financier et commercial Propre P&L opérationnelle, contrôle des coûts et indicateurs de productivité. Gérer les budgets d'exploitation, la planification du capex et les réserves du cycle de vie. Collaborer avec des équipes commerciales pour optimiser les revenus (F&B, détail, expériences, excursions à terre, le cas échéant). 6. Conformité, sécurité et gestion des risques Assurer la conformité continue à toutes les normes réglementaires, maritimes, sanitaires, de sécurité et environnementales. Diriger la préparation aux situations d'urgence, la gestion des crises et la planification de la continuité des opérations. Servir de cadre supérieur responsable pour les vérifications et les inspections. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 15 ans et plus leadership des opérations seniors dans l'hospitalité, les destinations de croisière, les stations balnéaires, les ports, les parcs à thème ou les grands actifs d'accueil. - Démonstration de la propriété des opérations avant l'ouverture et à long terme. - Forte expérience en collaboration avec les équipes de développement, de construction et de services techniques. - L'expérience dans les Caraïbes ou les îles est fortement préférée. Vos essentiels - Préparation opérationnelle et fonctionnement du cycle de vie - Leadership à grande échelle de la main-d'oeuvre - Responsabilité financière et P&L - Cycle de vie des actifs et gestion de l'entretien - Multi-exploitant et gestion des concessions Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les perspectives diverses, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être son authentique soi. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions. Your Impact - Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions. - Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards. - Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans. - Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements. - Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours. - Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation. - Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings. - Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations. - Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence. Your Journey so far - 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered. - 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders. - A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred. Your Essentials - Flexibility and strong analytical skills. - Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. - IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous. - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher). - Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery. - Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset. - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. - Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
